column1: # The fixture variants (crates/model/src/fixture/variant.rs, `just fixture-requant FAMILY TAG`): a family's fixture requantized by ik's
# llama-quantize to one type map, written to /models/fixture-variants/<tag>/<fixture dir>/, so a quant type's train gate runs on a small file.
#   tag      lower-case letters and digits; BLOOMERY_FIXTURE_VARIANT=<tag> selects the variant (tools/ref/ref-paths.sh), and it joins the
#            variant's set names (`fx_<tag>_...`) and its file name
#   family   the architecture the fixture declares (the BLOOMERY_MODEL profile name)
#   scope    `trunk`: every layer but the NextN one, which keeps the fixture's types
#   map      `role=type` words, a role being the tensor name between `blk.<L>.` and `.weight`, or the name of a tensor outside the
#            layers without its `.weight` (`token_embd`, `output`), a type ggml's name; every tensor
#            the map does not name keeps the fixture's type and bytes, and so does a tensor of a named role already at the
#            map's type while another of that role is not (a role whose every tensor is already at it is refused)
#   recipes  the gate recipes that run on the variant: the ones whose clauses read the retyped tensors, with BLOOMERY_FIXTURE_VARIANT=<tag>
#   why      the file the map is the small proof of; a map that retypes a tensor to a very-low-bit type names its flat importance matrix
#            `imatrix=sha256:<16 hex>` (tools/ref/flat-imatrix.py --check-row), a map that needs none names none
